priority_risk: Prior special-case treatments may be unindexed; full text of Kieroński–Otto (2005/2012) was not available for detailed statement-level comparison.
scientific_integrity: All-size bound and structural enumeration have a complete combinatorial proof; the finite programs replay separately the twelve templates and corroborate the twelve-element threshold. Known complexity and model-construction theorems are not claimed as novel.
scientific_limitations: Pure language of exactly two named equivalence relations with equality; ordinary pointed rank-one types, their maximal multiplicity, and the resulting rank-two sentence equivalence only. No classification of all rank-two theories, no counting-logic generalization.
title: Eight pointed types and twelve minimal extremizers for two equivalences
